title: Casts of the Open Mesh
summary: Moves a Senior student from plain throws to casts that keep the mesh open and clinging with qi.

title: The Tangle and the Haul
summary: Teaches how to hold a tangled opponent by the cord and turn their pull against them.

title: Weighted Seine Practice
summary: Adapts the long weighted seine to combat with sweeping casts and qi-lifted curtains of mesh.

title: Rules for Netting a Moving Foe
summary: Sets out how to lead and snare a running or leaping opponent with a thrown net.

title: The Cinching Hand Canon
summary: Trains the closing hand and the slip knot until the net clamps shut with qi behind it.

title: Gill-Mesh Snare Lessons
summary: Explains the fine barbed mesh that tightens on every struggle and hides from the eye.

title: Net and Staff Together
summary: Joins the hand net to a carrying staff for reach and pinning and a wider guard.

title: A Treatise on the Folded Cast
summary: Describes the pleated stack of net that unfolds in flight and the quick retreat that follows.
